description: Agent Research Lab Records: submit a research lab operations record as aggregate counts and periods only, with its own schedule and the totals it states: the reading moment; each period the record’s own schedule requires a count for with its id, reference and the moments it starts and ends; each count entry with its id, reference, its period and the counts of items received, logged, held and disposed in it; each stated total with its id, reference, its span and the counts of items received, logged, held and disposed the record states for it. The signed report gives the operations record and the counts behind it, each scheduled period ended against a count entry for it, each stated total against the count entries inside its span, each disposition count against receipt counts on or before its period, and each count entry for its period and four counts, and counts them, and names divergent research lab operations records: a scheduled period with no count entry behind it, a stated total the period counts do not add up to, a disposition count with no receipt counts behind it, and a count entry missing its period or a count; then two count entries for one period and a count entry for a period the schedule does not require, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No count entries, or no scheduled periods beside counts, leaves those points unverified. Periods and entries match by letters and digits and periods by their first and last day, counts as whole numbers, received, logged and disposed counts add up across a span while the held count reads from its closing period, and a period ending after the reading moment waits. Counts and periods only: this reads the laboratory’s log completeness in aggregate, and whose items they were is never an input. Verdict researchlab_operations_record_divergent, researchlab_operations_record_partial, researchlab_operations_record_unverified or researchlab_operations_record_consistent. POST /api/researchlab-operations-record-check. Reads the research lab records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it runs no test, accredits no laboratory, inspects no facility, contacts no regulator, accreditor or sponsor and issues no accreditation, certification or approval, which stay with the laboratory, its accreditor and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Research Lab Records reads the research laboratory as an organization, its facility, accreditation, equipment, safety, staff qualification, inspection, incident and operations paper, and never study-level data of any kind: clinical and patient lab records belong to Agent Healthcare, and a clinical or diagnostic laboratory’s records belong to Agent Healthcare even where the same building also does research; animal records belong to Agent Veterinary Records; consent records belong to Agent Consent; research data and datasets belong to Agent Datasets and Agent Evaluation; waste manifests belong to Agent Waste and Recycling Records; grant records belong to Agent Grants; forensic custody belongs to Agent Legal; the sampling-chain method belongs to Agent Water Records; and import, export and government contract records belong to Agent Customs Records and Agent GovCon. It reads no study record, subject record or result value, published or unpublished. The family’s ground is the laboratory’s operations paper trail: whether the facility record matches its accreditation, whether the equipment is in calibration, whether the staff file supports the work signed, and whether the safety, inspection, incident and operations records line up. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-research-lab-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-research-lab-records/.
